title: Real Estate Content Ideas: 30 Posts Builders and Brokers Can Use
seoTitle: Real Estate Content Ideas: 30 Posts for India
excerpt: Real estate content ideas for Indian builders and brokers: 30 post ideas, a weekly calendar, platform tips, RERA and ASCI rules, and what to measure.

faqs.question: What content should a real estate builder post on Instagram?
faqs.answer: Post content that removes a buyer's doubt before a site visit: dated construction progress, peak-hour commute clips, floor plan explainers in carpet area, RERA checks, payment plan breakdowns and site visit invitations. Rotate these pillars through the week so your feed is never only ads or renders.

faqs.question: How often should a real estate business post on social media?
faqs.answer: About five useful feed posts a week, plus Stories on most days, works for most builders and brokers. Consistency matters more than volume. Film on one day each week, schedule the posts in one sitting, and review saves, shares and WhatsApp clicks after a month before changing the plan.

faqs.question: What are good real estate content ideas for India?
faqs.answer: Monthly site walks, tower floor counters, sample flat walkthroughs with a tape measure, commute and metro clips, school and hospital maps, carpet vs built-up area explainers, price sheet breakdowns, home loan document checklists, possession and handover guides, and festival-season site visit schedules.

faqs.question: Do social media posts for a real estate project need the RERA number?
faqs.answer: Yes. A post that promotes a registered project is an advertisement, and the RERA Act requires promoters' ads to show the registration number and the authority's website. Some states, such as Maharashtra, also require a QR code. Put these details in the caption and on the image or first video frame.

faqs.question: Can I post AI renders of a project that is not built yet?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a clear label. ASCI's guidelines on synthetic content name a 3D model of an unbuilt housing complex as a case where labelling is mandatory. Write 'Artist's impression' or 'AI-generated visual' on the image itself, and never show amenities or views that are not in the approved plans.

faqs.question: Do paid channel partner or influencer posts need a disclosure?
faqs.answer: Yes. ASCI's influencer guidelines ask for an upfront, prominent label such as 'Ad', 'Sponsored', 'Collaboration' or 'Partnership' whenever there is a material connection with the brand. A disclosure placed only in the bio or at the end of a video is likely to be missed by viewers.

faqs.question: Are WhatsApp Channels useful for real estate?
faqs.answer: Yes, for one-way updates. Channels let you post text, photos, videos and polls to followers, who can react but not reply in the channel, and followers' phone numbers stay hidden. They suit construction updates for buyers and warm leads, while personal follow-ups belong in one-to-one chats.

faqs.question: How do I measure whether real estate content is working?
faqs.answer: Track saves, shares, WhatsApp clicks, DMs asking about price or visits, and site visits traced back to a post or campaign. Likes say little about buying intent. Tag every enquiry's source in your CRM and ask visitors at the gate where they first saw the project.
